name: Nocturne Koi Sanctuary
promptTemplate: A nocturnal koi sanctuary glowing in {{water_mood}} waters with {{koi_scale}}x scale fish swimming beneath {{lily_density}} layered pads, caustics set to {{caustics}} and ethereal spirit trails set to {{spirit_glow}}.

water_mood.hint: Shift pond deep palette and bioluminescence

koi_scale.hint: Enlarge or slenderize the swimming fish

lily_density.hint: Adjust count of floating pads and blossoms

spirit_glow.hint: Toggle ethereal trails flowing behind fish

feed.hint: Cast luminous pellets to summon the koi

listing.blurb: Glowing koi swim under layered lily pads in a deep nocturnal pond, darting toward scattered food pellets with radiant ripples.
listing.prompt: A koi pond at night, one glowing koi per person in the room in their colour, gliding under lily pads; anyone can scatter food at their fish, which sends ripples out and brings the koi racing to the surface. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
